name: Khoa nhan vat thuong mai
text: Giu nguyen tuyet doi khuon mat, voc dang, mau da, kieu toc cua nhan vat tu anh tham chieu. Khong tre hoa, khong doi net mat.

name: Khoa san pham
text: Giu nguyen mau ao, co ao, soc, logo va form ao tu anh tham chieu. Khong doi mau, khong them hoa tiet.

name: Video gioi thieu 3 shot
text: Shot 1 mim cuoi nhin camera va gioi thieu san pham. Shot 2 quay nhe thay form ao va chat vai. Shot 3 can canh co ao va logo roi nhin lai camera. Moi shot ket thuc giu yen roi cat cung.
